name: Cutie and the Beast
source: Dr. Alun Kendrick has the sexiest Welsh accent you've ever heard… and the worst scars you've ever seen. Working as his temporary office manager gives you a chance to get closer to him and unravel the supernatural mysteries that surround Dr. Kendrick and his patients. Can you tame this Beast and show him that beauty is in the eye of the beholder?
translation: 阿伦·肯德里克医生有着你听过的最性感的威尔士口音……还有你见过的最严重的伤疤。担任他的临时办公室经理让你有机会更接近他并解开围绕肯德里克医生和他的病人的超自然之谜。你能驯服这只野兽，让他知道情人眼里出西施吗？
